session_entry_template.notes: Absolute ns endpoints, when specified, are integer strings. Empty interval list does not automatically mean an entire session is unloaded.

selection_rules: Explicitly list one chosen summary for each physical trial; do not import csv and csv_recovered from the same session twice.
Templates are not data entries; fill verified values into sessions before running a future implementation.
Recorded ID0 alone does not establish an independently confirmed unloaded interval.
Calibration and calibration_validation trials are distinct from final evaluation test trials.
Changing target raw/kalman must use source-compatible validity and calibration.
Do not infer force units from ROS message type or directory name.
